note_text: Order 20001 cancelled after the customer's credit card was declined twice by the issuing bank during checkout retry.
Order 20002 stuck in Pending - the payment gateway timed out (ORD_TIMEOUT_502) and never confirmed the charge went through.
Order 20003 cancelled by the customer after noticing a duplicate charge appeared on their statement for the same order.
Order 20004 pending because the installment plan selected at checkout was rejected by the card issuer; customer asked to switch to full payment.
Order 20005 cancelled - PIX payment expired before confirmation, customer didn't complete it within the 30 minute window.
Order 20006 initially flagged for a payment mismatch (amount charged didn't match the cart total by $0.02, a rounding issue) - resolved manually, order confirmed.
Order 20007 cancelled after the customer's bank blocked the transaction as suspected fraud; customer confirmed by phone it was legitimate, but the order had already auto-cancelled.
Order 20008 shipped 4 days later than the estimated dispatch date because the regional carrier hub was backed up after a holiday.
Order 20009 tracking shows no movement for 6 days; carrier confirmed the package is still at the origin facility, no estimate yet.
Order 20010 delivered 9 days after the original estimate due to an incorrect postal code on file; corrected mid-transit by the carrier.
Order 20011 delayed because of severe weather along the delivery route; carrier pushed the estimate back by 3 business days.
Order 20012 customer asked about the delay - warehouse confirmed the item was out of stock for 2 days before it could actually be packed and handed to the carrier.
Order 20013 arrived late; customer was offered a store credit for the inconvenience, accepted.
Order 20014 the carrier's tracking page shows 'exception' status - package was mis-routed to the wrong distribution center, being corrected.
Order 20015 cancelled by the customer - item arrived with a cracked screen, customer requested a refund via PIX instead of a replacement.
Order 20016 delivered with the outer box crushed but the product inside was undamaged; customer kept the item, no action needed.
Order 20017 cancelled - the product leaked during transit and damaged other items in the package; full refund issued.
Order 20018 customer reported a missing accessory in the box; replacement accessory shipped separately, order itself stays Delivered.
Order 20019 cancelled after the customer sent photos showing the item arrived scratched and unusable; return label issued.
Order 20020 arrived with a dented corner on the packaging only - product tested fine, customer satisfied with a small discount on a future order instead of a return.
Order 20021 cancelled - wrong item received (different color/model than ordered), treated as a damaged/incorrect-item case, refund processed.
Order 20022 customer asked to change the delivery address to a different apartment number before dispatch; updated successfully since the order hadn't shipped yet.
Order 20023 customer requested an address change after the order had already shipped; informed the change can't be made through us and they need to contact the carrier directly.
Order 20024 customer realized they entered the wrong city during checkout; corrected while the order is still Pending.
Order 20025 address change requested to redirect delivery to a work address instead of home during business hours; updated.
Order 20026 customer asked post-delivery if the address could still be changed - explained that's not possible once an order is Delivered.
Order 20027 refund processed via PIX within 3 business days after the cancellation was confirmed.
Order 20028 customer asking why the refund hasn't appeared yet - confirmed it was issued 2 days ago, can take up to 5 business days to reflect depending on the bank.
Order 20029 partial refund issued - customer kept one of two items from a bundle and returned the other.
Order 20030 refund request denied - the cancellation was requested 45 days after delivery, past the eligibility window.
Order 20031 refund was issued to store credit instead of the original payment method, per the customer's own request.
Order 20032 customer disputed the refund amount - a shipping fee wasn't included; corrected and the difference was refunded separately.
Order 20033 customer asked if they could add another item to the same order before it ships; advised to place a separate order instead since this one is already processing.
Order 20034 customer asked for a gift receipt to be included in the package; noted on the order for the warehouse team.
Order 20035 customer requested an invoice with their company's tax ID for reimbursement purposes; sent via email.
Order 20036 customer asked whether the delivery person could call before arriving; forwarded the preference to the carrier, not guaranteed.
Order 20037 customer wanted to know if the product includes a warranty card; confirmed it's included inside the packaging.
Order 20038 cancelled - the customer's debit card had insufficient funds at checkout and the retry also failed.
Order 20039 payment stuck in Pending because the bank slip (boleto) hasn't been paid yet by the customer.
Order 20040 customer complained the delivery is taking longer than the 5-10 business day SLA; carrier confirmed it's now on day 12.
Order 20041 cancelled after the customer reported the box arrived soaking wet and the product inside no longer powers on.
Order 20042 customer moved and asked to update the delivery address to a new city entirely before the order gets confirmed.
Order 20043 refund issued after the customer cancelled within the first hour of purchase, well inside the eligibility window.
Order 20044 customer left positive feedback about the packaging and asked how to leave a product review; pointed to the review page.
Order 20045 cancelled - the one-time payment link expired before the customer completed checkout; a new order had to be placed from scratch.
